about: Bide with no one left to hit fails as from the fifth generation, "But it failed!" (subscript 282, BATTLE_SUBSCRIPT_BIDE_NO_TARGET; Showdown's gen-9 '-fail' where the fourth generation said "But there was no target..."), until now seen only by test_miss_lines. Falkner, from Route 29's save put in his room, against a level-40 Snorlax that knows only Bide (teach:), given Rough Skin and a Rocky Helmet (set:); his Hoothoot, 41 HP, knows only Extreme Speed, whose +2 beats Bide's +1 every turn, and is set to 33 HP: each contact costs it 11 (6 for the Helmet, 5 for the skin), so it stands at 22 and 11 after the first two turns -- not under a quarter, where the AI would spend a Super Potion -- and faints to the third, the turn Bide is released, before Snorlax moves. The energy stored from the second and third hits has no one to go to: the Hoothoot's place is empty until the turn's end, when Doduo comes in.
